# <span id="aanchor514"></span> Volume Editor

Accessing the Volume Editor requires **System Process – Meter Edit – Can View** privileges. For additional details about Volume Editor access, see: [Volume Editor Access Privileges](Volume%20Editor%20Access%20Privileges.md).

Use the Volume Editor to view and edit flow data, meter characteristics, and meter analysis for meters. Meters can be selected by list, location, or close group. You can view the data on a batch, periodic, daily, or monthly basis.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 614;height: 343;" />

 

<div class="procedure">

To view meter data in the Volume Editor:

1.  Go to **Open** \> **Volume Editor**.

2.  Select a meter, location, list, or close group.

    When a location, list or close group is selected, the meter number with focus is displayed in the title bar at the top left of the screen.

3.  Select a data type (e.g., Flow Data).

4.  Select the month and year for the data you want to view.

</div>

The following items are available on the Volume Editor screen:

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Menus">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Screen Menus</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Menus">

### Data

- **Rollup Viewer Graph** – Graph time frame where data exists for the selected meter.
- **Graphical Editor** – Edit periodic flow data.
- **Graph UFM** – Graph changes in ultrasonic data before and after selected month.
- **Run Validation** – Perform validations on the meter.
- **Split Periodic** – Create a new or missing periodic record that starts at the top of the time period (15-minute, hour, day, month). You can specify a date to split the periodic record. No calculations occur at the time of split, but you can provide totals after the split.
- **Export to Excel** – Export data for specific month to an excel spreadsheet.
- **Recalc** – Recalculate data after changes are made.
- **Save** – Save changes to data.
- **Refresh** – Reload the meter, source, or location from the database.
- **Locate** – Locate a subsequent record with specific criteria such as PPA pending or missing data.
- **Goto** – Locate records with specific data such as missing data or alarms for a specific month.

### Report

- **Standard Report** – Open the Reports screen with the meter pre-populated.
- **Exports** – Export data for selected time frame.
- **Test Report** – Open the TESTit Report Viewer for selected time frame.
- **Prove Reports** – Open a PDF of the prove report for a record (liquid meters only).

### Set-Up

- **Meter Editor** – Open the Meter Editor with the meter pre-populated.
- **Source Analysis** – Open the Quality Source Editor with the assigned source pre-populated.
- **Source Assignments** – Open the Quality Source Assignment Viewer with the meter number pre-populated.
- **Close Dates** – Open the meter data Close Dates screen with the meter number pre-populated for all dates.
- **Edit/PPA Approvals** – Open the PPA Approval Editor screen with the meter number pre-populated.
- **PPA Editor** – Open the PPA Editor screen with the meter number pre-populated.
- **Proving Adjustment** – Open the Liquid Prove Editor with the meter number pre-populated.

### Options

- **Current Flow Data** – Display the most current revision of meter data.
- **Original Flow Data** – Display imported data with no revisions.
- **Cell Editing** – Edit flowing parameters (pressure, temperature, and indicated volume) for multiple records at a time.
- **Row Editing** – Edit an entire data row for a single record or a span of time.
- **Move selection after enter**
  - **Up/Down** – When selected, your cursor will move down when you press **Enter** when cell editing.
  - **Left/Right** – When selected, your cursor will move to the right when you press **Enter** when cell editing.

### View

- **Grid Legend** – Open the tabular editor legend and display the overview of color codes and alarm state codes used in the Volume Editor. (See: [Grid Legend](Grid%20Legend.md))

- **Hide Grid Selection** – Enable or disable highlighted representation of a row or cell.

- **Hide Virtual Batches** – Enable or disable virtual batches for which Mass and NSV are empty.

  This option is only available in Batch view, not in Periodic, Daily, or Monthly views.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Object">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Object Selector</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Object">



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 593;height: 315;" />

- **System** - Contains a list of the FLOWCAL systems of which you are a member.

- **Meter/Location/List/Close Group** - Displays the number of the selected object.

  If you select a list, location, or close group, the meter on display out of the meters contained in the selected object will be identified in the title bar. You will be able to navigate through and filter the set of meters using the options that display next to the Measurement Month selector.

  

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 259;height: 32;" />

  - **Show All** - Display all meters in the selected object.
  - **Skip Empty** - Skip all meters that do not contain data for the selected measurement month.
  - **Show Incomplete** - Toggle through meters that are missing data.

  If a single meter is selected, the most current month range will display. When opening a list, location, or close group, click the left and right arrows next to the date selector to explore available meters in the selected object.

- **Name** – The name of the selected object.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Data">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Data Types</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Data">



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 603;height: 319;" />

- **Flow Data** – View and edit flow data points for the meter, such as Differential Pressure, Static Pressure, Temperature, Volume, and Energy.
- **Characteristic** – View and edit the characteristic information for the meter, such as Meter Type, Calc Method, Meter Direction, and Meter Class.
- **Analysis** – View and edit analysis information for the meter, such as Mole %, Relative Density, Heating Value, and Viscosity.
- **Equipment** – View and edit information for flow devices and transmitters.
- **Components** – View and edit fluid parameters, such as Pulses, Observed Density, and Meter Temperature and Pressure (only available for liquid meters).

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Month">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Measurement Month Selector</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Month">



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 597;height: 317;" />

- **Month/Year** – Select the month and year for data you want to display.

  The measurement month is defined by the Contract Day and Contract Hour values specified for the meter. If the meter does not have a Contract Day and Contract Hour specified for the date range, the grid will use the contract day and hour specified for the system of the meter.

- **Auto** – Check this option to automatically refresh the grid once a new selection has been made. If this option is not selected, click the **Open** button to refresh the grid when selecting a new object or measurement month.

  Settings for this option will be retained throughout your FLOWCAL session if the Volume Editor Auto Option is enabled in [User Preferences](../Settings%20Manager/User%20Settings/User%20Preferences.md).

If the "Remember UI Filter Values" option is enabled (see: [User Preferences](../Settings%20Manager/User%20Settings/User%20Preferences.md)), the Volume Editor will retain the filter and date settings for the duration of the FLOWCAL session. The filter date settings for the last Volume Editor session to be closed are retained when multiple Volume Editors are opened. The filter settings will reset when you log out or close FLOWCAL.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Detail">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Details Screen</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Detail">

On any Volume Editor grid, a row represents the date span that begins at the Effective Date displayed in the first column. users can double-click a row to open the Detail screen that shows the details of various data types for the date span.

### Gas Meter Detail



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" />

Detail screen opened from the Flow Data \> Periodic tab

The GPA 2172 tab is supported only for gas meters.

### Liquid Meter Detail



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" />

Detail screen opened from the Flow Data \> Batch tab

The Components sub-tab is supported only for liquid meters. The Batch menu option and the Accounting sub-tab only display for Batch details (i.e., when the Detail form is opened from the Batch grids).

</div>
